name: claude-account-switcher
description: Show and switch the Claude Code account used in this window, like the git branch.

commands.title: Claude Account: Switch account for this project
Claude Account: Choose the folder the session starts in
Claude Account: Show the accounts panel

claudeAccount.cliPath.description: Path to the claude-account executable. If empty, tries ~/.local/bin/claude-account and then the PATH. Needed because VS Code launched from the Dock has a reduced PATH.

claudeAccount.statusBarPriority.description: Priority of the status bar item. Higher = further left.

claudeAccount.usageLive.description: Ask the API for real usage figures. Off by default: it sends the account's OAuth token, read from the Keychain, to api.anthropic.com. With it off the panel shows cached values from .claude.json, which can be hours old. See SECURITY.md.

claudeAccount.usageStaleAfterMinutes.description: After how many minutes usage figures are flagged as out of date.

claudeAccount.usageInTooltip.description: Show a usage line in the status bar tooltip.

claudeAccount.usageRefreshMinutes.description: How often, in minutes, the panel asks the API for usage while it is open. 0 disables automatic refresh. Only applies when claudeAccount.usageLive is on.
